outbound-only.description: Operator machines. They can reach the servers; nothing can reach them. Add new operators in the dashboard.

ocs-rigs.description: GPU rigs running the orchestrator and Open WebUI.

ocs-macminis.description: The Mac minis. They join with a setup key that adds them here, so membership isn't listed (peers: null).

policies.name: gateway-to-rigs
policies.description: EC2 admission gateway -> rig orchestrator (9000) and Open WebUI (3000)

policies.name: rigs-to-rigs
policies.description: TEMPORARY: GPU rigs can reach each other both ways (Open WebUI on Rig 1 calling a model on Rig 2). Remove once a router (Mac Mini or EC2) sits between the rigs.

policies.name: outbound-only-to-infra
policies.description: Peers in outbound-only can reach the servers; nothing can reach them

policies.name: operators-to-macminis
policies.description: Operator laptops (the outbound-only group) -> Mac minis, any port. Replies come back; the Mac minis can't open connections to the laptops
